decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement (dated: 10/02/2016), HASA-150-10-0001, HASA-150-10-1001, HASA-150-10-2001, HASA-150-10-3001, HASA-150-11-0001, HASA-150-11-0002, HASA-150-11-0003, HASA-150-12-0001, Received: 19/02/2016.   HASA-150-20-0001 REV A, HASA-150-20-1001 REV A, HASA-150-20-3001 REV A, HASA-150-21-0002 REV A, HASA-150-22-0001, Received: 08/03/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house and replacement single storey rear extension
